main_measure.name: t-statistic of slope of forward 20-bar excess return on forecast (non-overlapping, pooled)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 and top-minus-bottom > 0; reject if t <= -2; otherwise inconclusive

supporting_check.name: mean forward 20-bar excess return, top fifth minus bottom fifth of forecasts

decided_by: The slope t-statistic lies between -2 and 2.
reading: Each coin's mean 20-bar return is taken over all bars of all its windows that have a forward return. The regression and the top/bottom fifths (cut at the 80th and 20th percentiles of forecasts) both use the same pooled non-overlapping sample at positions 0, 20, 40, ... of each window, and too few cases is reported as not observable.
